tips_en: Start with Paper 1, which tackles the most ambitious problem—long-horizon interactive world generation with persistent memory—via an elegant decoupled world-state bank that sidesteps the denoiser's context bottleneck. Paper 2 is a natural follow-up: it shares the Wan2.2 + DMD distillation recipe but specializes the framework for robotic manipulation, trading geometric scene persistence for fine-grained action and physics fidelity. Paper 3 is thematically separate (agentic AI for mechanistic interpretability) but worth reading afterward for a striking example of autonomous AI-driven discovery.
tips_zh: 建议先读第一篇，它解决了最雄心勃勃的问题——通过解耦的外部世界状态库，巧妙绕开了去噪器上下文增长的瓶颈，实现了长时序、持久且可交互的视频生成。第二篇是自然的延伸：同样基于 Wan2.2 + DMD 蒸馏框架，但聚焦于机器人操作，以动作保真度和物理一致性为核心。第三篇主题不同（用于机制可解释性的智能体 AI），但作为展现 AI 自主科学发现能力的精彩案例，值得后续阅读。
